title: On Recalling the day exactly thirty years on
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：recall　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recall 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the driver ① recalled the day exactly thirty years on for the whole place, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② recalls the day exactly thirty years on without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ recall the day exactly thirty years on at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ recalled the day exactly thirty years on before — a line in the timetable for February 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Recalling the day exactly thirty years on for the whole place, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ recall the old tutor at once without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Recall the old tutor at once at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ recalls the old tutor at once for the whole place every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ recalled the day exactly thirty years on again when nobody else would.

⑩ To recall the day exactly thirty years on, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody recalls the day exactly thirty years on without a word of thanks again and somebody must recall the day exactly thirty years on for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 回忆起（一般过去式 recalled the day exactly thirty years on：1973 年司机头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 回忆起（一般现在 recalls the day exactly thirty years on：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 回忆起（不定式 to recall the day exactly thirty years on：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 回忆起（过去完成时 had recalled the day exactly thirty years on：1967 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 回忆起（动名词 recalling the day exactly thirty years on 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 召回（recall the old tutor at once：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去召回当即把那位老先生请回来）
G. v. 召回（recall the old tutor at once：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 回忆起（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 recalls the old tutor at once，而母亲又一次 recalled the day exactly thirty years on）

answers.why: recall 意为“回忆起”，1973 年司机替所有人回忆起隔了整整三十年仍能记起那天，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 recalled。
recall 意为“回忆起”，自那以后司机不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 recalls。
recall 意为“回忆起”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯回忆起隔了整整三十年仍能记起那天”，此处为不定式 to recall the day exactly thirty years on。
recall 意为“回忆起”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人回忆起过，故用过去完成时 had recalled。
recall 意为“回忆起”，司机说“回忆起隔了整整三十年仍能记起那天这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 recalling the day exactly thirty years on 作主语。
recall 意为“召回”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去召回当即把那位老先生请回来”，should ever 之后用原形 recall the old tutor at once。
recall 意为“召回”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻召回当即把那位老先生请回来（recall the old tutor at once at once），以后再也不要提起。
recall 意为“回忆起”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例召回当即把那位老先生请回来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 recalls。
recall 意为“回忆起”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人回忆起隔了整整三十年仍能记起那天，用一般过去式 recalled 叙述。
recall 意为“回忆起”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要回忆起隔了整整三十年仍能记起那天，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recall 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the driver recalled the day exactly thirty years on for the whole place, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver recalls the day exactly thirty years on without a word of thanks whenever the station asks.
Recalling the day exactly thirty years on for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever recall the old tutor at once without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station recalls the old tutor at once for the whole place every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother recalled the day exactly thirty years on again, and the station remembered that half.
